_comment: Apps whose probes are expected to fail today. An entry needs an app and a reason, and
the reason is read by a person, not by the runner. An app listed here is reported as
'expected fail (reason)' and does not break the exit code.
The list cannot go stale in either direction: an app listed here that starts PASSING
fails the run until it is taken off, and an entry naming an app with no probe is
reported as a note. Nothing else in this suite can turn a failing check green.
This is not a place to park a known bug. It is for a probe that cannot run yet.
